title: Film programming Antwerp Bari Ghent Gothenburg Leicester Rotterdam 1952
descriptions: This data collection presents a fully harmonized data set originating in several research projects on post-war cinema programming. The collection consists of data of feature films screened for public viewing in cinemas in the cities Bari (Italy), Antwerp and Ghent (Belgium), Gothenburg (Sweden), Leicester (United Kingdom) and Rotterdam (Netherlands) for the year 1952.
